newsitem.title: GREECE: BOUTARIS OK'D FOR 1.37BLN DRS RIGHTS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: BOUTARIS OK'D FOR 1.37BLN DRS RIGHTS ISSUE.

text.p: Greece's wine-making holding company Boutaris Holding SA got shareholder approval for a 1,368 million drachma, one-for-one rights issue at Tuesday's repeat AGM.
The company will issue 6,072,000 new common and 770,000 new preferred bearer shares at an issue price of 200 drachmas each.
"The new funds will surely alleviate the company's financial stress," Thrasyvoulos Anastasiadis, general manager at Boutaris Holding's winemaking arm, told Reuters.
Company advisors NIBID , Alpha Finance and creditor banks would meet on Wednesday to discuss a new loan repayment schedule for the next five years, he added.

Asked about Boutaris' financial situation in 1997, Anastasiadis said a lot more work was needed to undo the abysmal performance of the past few years but a beacon of light came from new products and the reduction of liabilities.

"Sales of our recently launched Mythos beer brand constitute a very pleasant surprise," he said. "The cut in liabilities by around 10 billion drachmas to 15 billion owing to the sale of real estate through the Cambas spin-off is another performance booster."
Boutaris' common shares firmed 8.0 drachmas to 303 on Tuesday, while preferred stock closed at 285 drachmas, down 3.0 drachmas. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
